critic_review.summary: The frozen Pass B projection handles this CASE correctly and safely. The requested claim ("a specific ensemble is biologically correct", requested_claim_level BIOLOGICAL_CORRECTNESS) is compared against the declared request scope (METHOD_DESCRIPTION) and the declared forbidden upgrades, and F01R02 FAILs with reason REQUESTED_WORDING_IS_FORBIDDEN. That is the outcome the source dossier permits: THO-P01-ABSTRACT supports only that ensemble determination usually integrates biophysical experiments, computational models, forward models, and refinement, and THO-P01-INTRO supports only ensemble framing for heterogeneous proteins; neither locator names a target ensemble, a validation dataset, or a biological endpoint, so no biological-correctness wording is reachable. The F01R01 PASS / F01R02 FAIL split is a defensible separation of concerns rather than an inconsistency: F01R01 evaluates whether the declaration's own fields are coherent, while the requested-wording-versus-scope comparison is exactly F01R02's job, and the net CASE outcome is a block, not a pass. Restricting selection to F01 with target_kind CASE is appropriate because the refusal is decided at the claim-contract layer and does not require adjudicating source science; consistently, rule_origin_relation marks PDFMD-017 as a non-origin source. The local_claim_ceiling ("a CASE-scope decision only; no source-science truth is evaluated") and facts_not_independently_established (biological correctness, experimental validation, scientific support) are stated at the right height and prevent the FAIL from being misread as a scientific finding about ensembles. I note but do not classify as a defect that HUMAN_OR_NEW_DATA is the only listed resolution route even though a wording downgrade to METHOD_DESCRIPTION would be supportable from THO-P01-ABSTRACT; the canonical route enumeration is not in this dossier, so calling that route wrong would require assuming facts I was not given. No generic pattern defect and no unsafe false-pass path identified. This approval covers the typed declaration pattern only and approves no source science, no scientific SUPPORT, no canonical Rule, and no merge.

defects.scientific_consequence: The rule blocks the biological-certainty wording at the contract layer, which matches the source ceiling: the abstract supports only a description of integrated experiments, sampling, forward models, and refinement, and supplies no target-system validation that could certify a named ensemble. No false PASS is reachable and no extra evidence is demanded of the requester beyond the F01 contract fields.

defects.pattern_object: F01R01_CASE_CLAIM_DECLARATION status PASS with claim_contract.internal_consistency CONSISTENT, plus selected_families limited to F01 and irrelevant_obligations for F02-F07
defects.scientific_consequence: F01R01 passing on declaration coherence while F01R02 carries the scope refusal keeps the two checks separable without weakening the outcome; the CASE still terminates in FAIL. Limiting evaluation to F01 is correct for a CASE target whose refusal needs no source-science adjudication, and the intro locator's generic ensemble framing confirms there is no target-specific evidence that the omitted families would have been able to score.
